title: Mixed Event — Rise as One!

meta.Outline: On one of his daily runs, Akito has an encounter with a dog and his owner. The pair has been training day by day in the hopes of one day winning a national disc dog competition. But the day before their next competition, this dog owner sprains his ankle...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (That's it for my run, but I still feel pretty good...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I think I'll do another lap after I get a drink of water. The vending machines should be...)

Ready, Max?
Okay... Go get it!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (That guy's here with his dog again. They've been here basically every day recently...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (And that thing they're playing with... It's called a flying disc, right...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It's not that big a dog, but it looks pretty intense when it's running around...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Anyway, I need to grab some water.)

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line:
Sir!
I'm sorry, but our flying disc flew your way and...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Wait a second...
If their disc's over here, then that means...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
No...!
I-It's coming right towards me...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Wait, the disc...!
If I throw it somewhere far in that direction...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Did I go a little overboard there...?
I'm not sure it'll be able to get...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
What? No way...
It caught it by jumping?

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line:
I-I'm so sorry...!
Are you alright?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm okay...
I'm also sorry for throwing your disc without asking.

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: Still, seeing him charge towards you like that must've been very startling. I apologize for not being able to stop him sooner. I put an extra-long leash on him, but panicked and couldn't get a good grip on it...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Oh, he did have a leash on. I got all worked up over noth—)

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line:
Welcome back, Max.
That was an amazing catch you made back there! I didn't think you'd be able to get it after seeing how far our friend here threw your disc.

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: Speaking of which, that was a beautiful throw! Your form was remarkable! Do you play ultimate a lot?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, um... I haven't thrown a flying disc since I was little.

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: Really?! Then, you must be a natural athlete! I wish I could do what you can! I'm still working on how to throw one of these properly...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
O-Oh, I see...
That explains why you two have been here so often lately.

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: I've actually been thinking about entering us into an agility contest that involves dogs catching discs... It's called “disc dog”.

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: Yes! And those who do well in enough of them get to compete on the national stage.

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: Our dream is to become the number one team in the country!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, I think he just replied to you...

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line:
Haha. I think so too...
Sometimes it seems like he knows exactly what I'm saying.

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: But Border Collies are very smart, so maybe he does understand...

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry. I've been going on and on about Max without introducing myself. My name is Itsuki Ishihara. And you are...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Akito Shinonome.
Also, I'm still in high school, so I'm not as old as you may think I am.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
Wait, I'm also a high schooler!
It's nice to meet you, Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
It was nice meeting you both.
Anyway, I should get going...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Huh?! H-He's looking right at me for some reason...)

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
What's the matter, Max?
Oh, do you want Shinonome to pet you...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? He wants me to pet him?

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Yes. After he's pulled off a nice play, he always sits like this and asks for pets.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: He wants you to pet him because you were the one who threw the disc last.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Do you not like dogs, Shinonome?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Umm, well... I'm not the biggest fan of them.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
No, I'm so sorry for not asking sooner!
Also, I apologize for keeping you here so long...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Nah, that's okay. I should've said something sooner too.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Our dream is to become the number one team in the country!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (They're also working towards a goal as partners...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, I feel like running that extra mile now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Phew... Let's end practice here for today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay!
Whew! I worked up a good sweat!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Nice work today. You all sounded great. You really stayed focused until the end.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you, Miku. I think we were able to because you were all here to watch.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, Honami...
Can we work on the interlude together sometime? We kinda fell out of tempo for a second there...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, I was actually going to ask you the same thing.
In that case, why don't we meet here early tomorrow?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay. What time do you wanna start?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Let's see... I should be done walking Shibao around nine, so how about a little bit after that?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sounds good. Then let's meet half past nine.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Right. I forgot that you still have to take Shibao out for walks even on your days off.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, taking care of a dog sounds like a lot of work.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, it does!
You'd get tired of it so fast, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Look who's talking.
You're always staying up so late that you can't wake up at a normal time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait a second. I feel like your walks with Shibao used to end much earlier...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, she's right!
The last time we all went out for a walk together, I wanna say we were back by around eight...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: When he went in for his regular checkup the other day, the vet told us that he's overweight. So, during my days off, I try to take him to the dog park.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, the vet said that he'll be just fine as long as he exercises regularly.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hang on. KAITO, have you met Shibao before?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You two became friends during Operation: Babysit Bashi, right?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Bashi...? Did you really need to come up with a weird nickname for Shibao?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What? It's not weird. It's cute!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I like it since it rhymes with Sakki♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, the other day, I had to keep an eye on Shibao all by myself because everyone else at home was gone...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But we had practice that day, so I couldn't stay by his side all day...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I was a little worried since Shibao isn't used to spending a lot of time on his own.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That was when KAITO agreed to watch Bashi while Hona went off to practice☆

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She left a tablet he could keep watch from in her room. That way, he could tell her right away if anything happened to Shibao.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, KAITO, why you?
Do you secretly like dogs or something?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Umm... I was told that someone on the animal caretaker committee should volunteer.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Someone on the animal caretaker committee...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The truth is, we've been copying all of you in terms of committee assignments.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, really?!
Oh, does that mean one of you is on the school festival planning committee like me...?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yup!
It's not exactly the same, but Len and I are on the fun and games committee!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: To be fair, it wasn't meant to be all that serious. It's just a convenient way for us to divide up the work around here. For example, Luka's on the cleanup committee, so she'd lead if we needed to do some tidying up.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Which is how we decided that a member of the animal caretaker committee should help sit Shibao.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you very much again for keeping an eye on Shibao for me that time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Please come visit again sometime.
I'm sure he'd love to see you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
He would...?
In that case, it might be nice to join you two for one of your walks.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, speaking of walks...
Hanasato and I will be taking Shibao and Samo on one together this Saturday.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Samo's Minori's dog, right?!
That sounds like fun! It'll be like a double date! A double walk...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Come to think of it, I remember Minori saying that Samo gets really excited and tugs on his leash whenever he sees Shibao.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Shibao too.
He always wants to go home after we've walked for a while, but the opposite happens whenever he's with Samo.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. That sounds like just the sort of exercise he needs.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I hope you two have a great walk, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Phew...
That should be enough for today.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, I haven't seen Ishihara or Max at all today...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(That explains why things seemed so quiet.
They always practice here around this time...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(So much for peace and quiet.
I hear two dogs, but don't see them anywhere...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wah! Samo, I know you're excited to see Shibao, but you need to settle down! This isn't safe!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. It has been a little while.
Shibao's tail won't stop wagging.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, you're right! Hehe. That's so cute...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, lemme introduce you guys!
This is Akito Shinonome. He sings with Kohane as part of the same team.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
With Kohane...?
Oh, I think I remember seeing your team perform at Shibuya Festa.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's nice to meet you. My name is Honami Mochizuki. I'm in the same year as Hanasato.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, um... It's nice to meet you as well...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Why does it seem like everyone who comes up to talk to me like this owns a dog...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm sorry, but are you not all that fond of dogs, Shinonome...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
No, uh...
It's not that I dislike them or anything...

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: No, Max, don't go that way!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
S-So it is true...!
I'm so sorry, Shinonome! I really had no idea!

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: I know you're excited about tomorrow's competition, Max, but you need to behave yourself...

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right.
We're taking part in a disc dog competition.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow! That has dogs jumping in the air and stuff to catch discs, right?! Your dog must be really agile!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Agile enough to be in a competition...
I wish you both the best of luck.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
Thank you very much!
Alright, Max, let's start practicing... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: What's wrong? Why aren't you moving?

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: You don't hate flying discs all of a sudden, do you? Ready? Come this way!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Is it just me, or is Ishihara's ankle...?)

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: No, don't yank on your leash like that!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ishihara, did you hurt your ankle...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But it looks like you're not putting any weight on your left side.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
Haha. Pretty stupid of me, right...?
But I can still throw since it's just a light sprain.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Still, you've gotta be careful. It's going to take a lot longer to heal if you don't rest properly...

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
Thanks, I know.
But I'm okay, honest! Just watch! Catch...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (He says he's fine, but he's not moving like he's fine...)

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Huh? Why aren't you running? I said, “Go!”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Max decided to sit down...

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
What's wrong, Max?
The competition's tomorrow, remember...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What if Max knows that you're hurt...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I think he's staying put because he doesn't want you to keep throwing that disc...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, so...
He doesn't want to fetch the disc because he doesn't want to force his partner to keep throwing it?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Which means Max is going out of his way to disobey Ishihara because he's worried about his partner's ankle...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (On the other hand, are dogs even capable of that sort of thought...?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, he's rubbing his head against your ankle...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I know this isn't really any of my business, but I don't think you should push yourself any further...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I feel that Max would be so sad if anything were to happen to you...

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Thanks for showing so much concern for me, Max. I'll take it easy tomorrow to let my ankle heal instead of participating in the competition...

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: We've been practicing so hard for tomorrow, but can't participate now because of a mistake I made...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(I get how he feels...
I'd be frustrated too after practicing every day like they have.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Even more so if it also makes your partner's efforts go to waste...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, would it be possible for Max and I to enter into that competition...?!

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Well, you can technically register the day of, so I don't see why not...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, if it's okay with you, Ishihara, I'll compete in your place!

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
Yes, Max would still get to compete...
But are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes! Please let me do this!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I want to show my support for Max since he's been working so hard towards your guys' dream!

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Thank you for your kind offer, Hanasato...

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Max and I need to build up a good record together in order to compete on the national stage...

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
But I don't want his efforts to go to waste.
I want him to compete and do his best.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Of course! You can count on me...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Alright, lemme give this a try!
Ready, Max?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Whoa, that's got some pepper to it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Nooo!
Why'd it go that way?!

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Uhh... It sliced a little, but you definitely get full marks for power!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: A little? It flew completely sideways.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, is Max looking for the disc?
It went that way! Over there!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sob*
I'm sorry. I didn't think it'd be this hard.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
Th-That's okay!
It also took me a long time to get the hang of throwing one of these!

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Plus, you have to practice a lot to get it to fly where you want. Now I feel like I'm asking too much of you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh... But if I keep practicing more and more...

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: No. I really appreciate the thought, but I can't force you to do all that just for us...

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: As terrible as I feel about Max, we're just going to have to give up on tomorrow's competition.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Wait, Shinonome...
Doesn't this mean Max wants you to take the disc...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, look!
He's pawing at it like he wants you to throw it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hang on...
Does this mean he wants to enter into that competition with you?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, don't put words in his mouth. I mean, you don't seriously believe...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Actually, I think she may be right...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Um, it's just...
Max has such a serious expression on his face right now...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: He may've noticed how frustrated Ishihara is over not being able to participate in that competition, and decided that he wants to enter...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Yeah, it does look like he's trying to tell us something...)

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Oh, I think I know why...

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: He must've remembered how well you threw his disc the other day.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Wait, the disc...!
If I throw it somewhere far in that direction...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I'll enter into that competition with Max...
Based on what I did last time, I think I have a good idea of how to throw one of these.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: But... Shinonome, I thought you didn't like...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I don't know how things are going to turn out...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Let's just say I understand how you feel when it comes to not wanting to let your partner down.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
Then, if you're really sure...!
I promise to give you guys all the support I can.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: In that case, may I help out as well...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I may be able to give you some assistance since I'm used to taking care of dogs.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Shibao and Samo said they also want to help!

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
That'd be great...!
I can't help retrieve the disc and stuff because of my ankle...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, it would be nice to have a few extra hands available...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, let's all do our best.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Alright, let me give you guys a quick rundown of the rules.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: It's actually pretty simple. The thrower will throw the disc, and you get points if your dog catches it...

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: You have sixty seconds to throw it as many times as you like, and you'll be competing based on how many points you can score.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I see... So, you want to get in as many throws as possible during that time?

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
Actually, that's not entirely the case.
You can score more points if your dog makes a long-distance catch.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Which means you can form a strategy based on a lot of short throws or try to maximize the points you score with each throw by going long.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Exactly! Also, you get no points if the disc hits the ground first.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: That's why I've been aiming up a little and having Max make catches by jumping.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah... Now that you mention it, even when I threw his disc in a panic the other day, he jumped up to catch it.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: I can show you how high and far Max likes you to throw the disc as we go along.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
Anyway, let's start practicing.
Once you've gotten the hang of throwing the disc, we'll let Max join in.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, in that case...
Would you like us to keep an eye on Max in the meantime?

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
That'd be great...!
Thank you both very much.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Keep your arm flat while at chest level and...)

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
Whoa! Nice throw, Shinonome...!
Your control's perfect!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I think I've got the hang of things.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I'll go let the others know that we're going to start practicing with Max!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Things have been going well so far, but the hard part starts here...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Your dog catching the disc you've thrown isn't the end of it. You have to get it back in order to throw it again.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Getting a disc back from a charging dog...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Now's not the time for that...
You've gotta honor the commitment you've made.)

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
Thanks for waiting, Shinonome!
We're back!

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Okay, let me know if you don't feel comfortable. I'll make sure to stop Max.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh wow... That's incredible, Shinonome.
The disc's flying so straight.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, and Max is going right after it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, he jumped up and caught it! That was so cool...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Now I have to get it back from him and throw it again...)

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: I'm sorry, Shinonome. I know this isn't easy for you...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Why are you apologizing?
I chose to take this on.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If anything, I should be the one apologizing for freaking out. I know he's your partner...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Lemme give it another try...
I'll get it right this time for su—

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Huh? That wasn't Max or either of our other dogs. Was someone else's nearby...?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What are the odds of us bumping into each other here?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, Mochizuki, Hanasato.
How have you both been? Good, I hope.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, and it's very nice to see you again!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, he's a senior at my school. Not the best example, though.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Is this your dog, Kamishiro?
It's so cute and fluffy and... Hang on a second...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's making this sort of buzzing noise...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I happened to come across this old build while cleaning my room. So, I decided to give it some upgrades and take it out for a walk to see if it still works.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wh-What...?!
You made this dog yourself, Kamishiro?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What can't you make at this point...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Whoa, it even barks like a real dog...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, can I ask what you were all doing just now...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, we were practicing for a disc dog competition...

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Yes. He's taking my place due to an injury that I've sustained.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, I see.
Still, are you sure about this...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Based on your behavior, I get the feeling that you're having quite a lot of trouble.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In particular, when it comes to interacting with a dog.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I'd rather you didn't underestimate a director's intuition.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But you're right. It hasn't been going all that well...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I see...
You have no problem throwing the disc, but have trouble taking it back from the dog.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yes. That's why I need to get back to practicing...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I could conceivably take his place in this competition...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But Shinonome seems to be doing his best to work with Max...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (So, I should try giving him whatever support I can.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I understand why you feel so pressured since the competition is tomorrow, but I feel that you first need to get used to being with a dog before practicing with the disc...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I fear that you'll never succeed while this phobia of yours goes unresolved.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
So, let's see...
You could start by petting or playing with him.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Me too...
I feel that you'll be able to take the disc from him without any issues if you take things slowly one step at a time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
...
Yeah, I guess that makes sense...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I'm still not sure about petting him...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, in that case, why don't I start by petting him while you watch...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: He's only just met me. So, seeing me pet him should in theory make things a little easier for you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: First, introduce yourself by letting him smell the back of your hand. Like this...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. Dogs are no different from us humans. We don't like being touched by strangers.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Which is why it's important to give dogs a chance to first learn your scent. That's the initial step towards forming a bond with them.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: When you go to pet him, try starting by gently scratching his jaw. I'd avoid his head or bottom since many dogs don't like being touched there immediately.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's about it. How do you feel, Shinonome...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, I'll give it a try...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (First, present the back of your hand...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This is going to be far more difficult than I realized...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Argh! I can't stop my body from pulling away whenever a dog comes near...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Is it impossible for me to even introduce myself to him...?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: May I ask how long you've been afraid of dogs, Shinonome?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Understanding the root cause of your phobia may help us find the right solution. Would you mind telling us what happened exactly?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It happened one day when I was still in preschool. I went to play at the park with my family and...

rows.Speaker: Little Akito
rows.Line: Huh? Why'd you kick the ball over there, Ena?

rows.Speaker: Little Ena's Voice
rows.Line:
Shut up.
Just go get it already!

rows.Speaker: Woman's Voice
rows.Line: No, Marron, wait! Don't go that way...!

rows.Speaker: Little Akito
rows.Line: (Hm? Was that a dog barking? Where is it...?)

rows.Speaker: Little Akito
rows.Line:
(N-No, we made eye contact!
What if it tries to attack me...?)

rows.Speaker: Little Akito
rows.Line: Wh-What do you want with me?!

rows.Speaker: Mother's Voice
rows.Line:
No, Akito, stop!
If you run, it'll...!

rows.Speaker: Little Akito
rows.Line:
(Wh-What do I do...?!
I've gotta find somewhere it can't go...)

rows.Speaker: Little Akito
rows.Line: (Wait, the slide! I just have to climb up there...!)

rows.Speaker: Little Akito
rows.Line: (Don't tell me it's waiting for me to come down!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I was told later that it thought I wanted to play when it saw me run.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But ever since that day, I flinch or freeze up whenever I see a dog...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And it gets worse if I see one running towards me or if one comes near my face.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, so when Max runs back to you with the disc...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It reminds you of that dog, and you end up reliving that past trauma.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, based on the rules of the competition, you'll need to be able to take the disc back from Max. This is turning into quite the puzzle...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(This is a tough one...
But if I don't do something...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hey, everyone...!
Why don't we take a quick break here?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We spent all morning practicing... I think we'll be able to come up with some better ideas after we've had a chance to catch our breaths!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. I agree.
I saw some food stalls nearby, so why don't we all get some lunch together?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright...
Then, let's take a quick break.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Samo, no!
You can't have this hot dog! Down, boy!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Shinonome's looked so deep in thought during our entire break.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (How do we cure him of his fear of dogs...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Oh, he's pawing at my bag...
Does he think there are treats inside?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If you want a treat, Shibao, you'll have to wait until we get home... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Shibao's been begging for some treats.
I'd like to get some water for him as well, so we'll be over there...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, right! You did say that Shibao has a big appetite!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(I'm so sorry, Shibao...!
You've been so patient about cutting back on treats...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<I'm sorry if I came at a bad time.
I was just hoping to see Shibao again...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, thank you for coming to visit him.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We don't have much time to talk right now, but aren't you glad he came, Shibao...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, KAITO, look...!
Shibao's so excited that he can't stop shaking his bottom, let alone his tail.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Shibao, wait.
I know you're excited, but you shouldn't bark so loudly.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <It's okay. I know he means well.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <But I was a little startled when I heard him bark for the first time...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wait, the first time? Do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Yes, when I babysat him the other day.
He barked in the same way...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I-I'm so sorry...!
Shibao, you naughty boy...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But his bark doesn't scare you now? Why is that...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I have a better understanding of who he is now.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Initially, I was under the impression that Shibao was barking because he saw me as some kind of threat.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I mean, I'd be on guard too if someone I didn't know came into my house...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I see what you mean...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <That's why I did my best to keep an eye on him without leaving the screen...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <But I soon realized that I had Shibao all wrong.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Shibao's been staring at the door for quite a while now...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Is he feeling lonely? Does he miss Honami and her family? He even has a bit of a sad look on his face...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
(Uh-oh... He barked at me.
Maybe I shouldn't have come out...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
(Oh, he's back... Huh?
With something in his mouth.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Does this mean you want to play...?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Is that also why he barked at me earlier? He wasn't trying to intimidate me... He just wanted me to play with him...?)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I apologize for jumping to the wrong conclusion. I was under the impression that you were the cautious type...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <But really, you're more of a mischievous one, and all you wanted was a little attention.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
(But what do I do...?
I can't throw the ball for him...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
(What music would Shibao like...?
Oh, he might recognize one of the songs that Honami said she likes.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <That's how I got to know Shibao better, and now I don't feel scared when he barks.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Learning to trust that he isn't going to attack me out of the blue or anything like that probably helps.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wow, I really had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Getting to know a dog, and learning how to place your trust in them...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (That may be the key to helping Shinonome. He might feel less afraid of Max if he gets to know him better and develops that trust.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: There's this problem that I've been having trouble trying to figure out, but I think I know what to do now after hearing your story...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Really? I can't say that I fully understand...>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I should get to know Max better...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, such as what makes him happy or upset...
As well as how he moves and reacts to things...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If you learn those things and develop some trust, I have a feeling that you'll become much more comfortable around him.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I guess I get what she's saying...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But is learning more about who he is really gonna help me feel less scared...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (No, I have to give it a try...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (The reason I said I'd take Ishihara's place in that competition at all is because I could tell Max cares about his partner.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (If I can learn more about Max's personality like Mochizuki said, then...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Okay...
I'll give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Still, how exactly am I supposed to get to know Max better...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, about that...
Why don't we start by watching how he behaves normally?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
We can stand at a bit of a distance.
That should be less stressful for you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
That sounds good.
The simple act of observing with interest should give you more than enough information.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I know! What if we all...?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, Shibao, don't tug on your leash!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They're so excited about making new friends!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Who would've guessed the day would come when I'd be dog-watching...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I feel like I'm not learning much just seeing him walk around like this... Is this enough?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Uhh... Okay.
We are standing pretty far away.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I'm not sure if I'm really learning anything about Max.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Really? I thought going for a walk together was a wonderful idea.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For example, Samo's walking in lockstep with Hanasato, which tells me that he likes receiving attention from her...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Shibao has a strong sense of curiosity.
So strong that he can't seem to stay away from Robo-Dog.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Shall we put that to the test?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What?!
Did Robo-Dog just jump up and twirl around in the air?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh... Hehe.
Shibao can't seem to get enough of him.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! He's sniffing him so much!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Wait, why's it able to jump like that...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Still, it's pretty clear now that each dog has a different personality...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (He walks a lot slower than the other dogs...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (He's even stopping to look at Ishihara from time to time for some reason...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Is he worrying about his partner's ankle...?)

rows.Speaker: Child
rows.Line: Whoa! Look at all the doggies!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Stop! You shouldn't try to touch them without asking. I'm so sorry...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
Hehe. Do you like dogs?

rows.Speaker: Child
rows.Line: Yeah! It's really cool how smooth this one's fur is!

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
Oh, are you talking about Max?
Would you like to try petting him?

rows.Speaker: Child
rows.Line:
Really?! Yay!
Hehe. I'm gonna pet his head!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'd avoid his head or bottom since many dogs don't like being touched there immediately.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (He's fine with it? No, he looks a little uncomfortable... But he's not doing anything about it...)

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
That's wonderful.
Now, you should thank this young man for letting you pet his dog.

rows.Speaker: Child
rows.Line:
Okay! Thanks for letting me pet your dog!
Bye bye, doggie!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Thank you for being so kind.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: He didn't like being touched on the head, right?

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
Oh, right.
But Max wouldn't kick up a fuss over that.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: He also knew that it was a kid who was petting him... He's just a really nice guy!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (He's been worried sick about his partner's ankle...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (And he didn't bark at that kid or anything, even though he was uncomfortable.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: How do you feel now, Shinonome?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I think I have a slightly better idea of what he's like. I'm definitely less scared of him now...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, it did! Then, why don't we keep watching Max for a little while longer?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, but... I don't know how much more I'll get out of just watching him go for a walk...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, right... Maybe we should have him do a few different things.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In that case, why don't we try something a little more interesting next...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Wow, you really caught it!
Good boy, Shibao!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
D-Down, Samo!
I know you want a hug! But you're so heavy!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I was wondering what he meant by “more interesting”... They're just having me watch while they toss discs around with their dogs.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I'm less comfortable with this, but it doesn't look too hard...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, Shinonome, why don't we also get started.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'll be throwing the disc.
You watch what Max does, as you have been.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also, for this exercise, I'll need you to stand right next to me. Do you think you can do that?

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
Sorry, Kamishiro.
I wish I could throw for Max...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's okay. You're injured, and seeing how Max behaves should help me come up with some upgrades for Robo-Dog.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Alright, just watching isn't really an issue...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (And I feel a bit better knowing Max has a kind personality...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It's not like Max is gonna bite me or anything... But I can't stop myself from flinching...!)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Looks like we still have some work to do...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I was hoping that you'd feel more comfortable around Max after getting to understand who he is better...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But the sight of a dog charging towards you seems to be at the core of this fear of yours.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which means no amount of reasoning is going to help. You just need to get used to being in this situation...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I can't say for sure since I'm no expert in this matter.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, I've heard that it takes quite a long time to overcome such past trauma...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I don't have that long...
The competition's tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But I don't have time to think of another solution either. If brute force and repetition is my only chance, then I've gotta use this time to get over this...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh no!
Shinonome, everyone, I'm sorry!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I didn't mean to throw my disc towards you...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
No...!
Samo's running right towards us!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The disc's going to hit Shinonome!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (A dog's coming this way... My body's frozen up.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Max stepped in front of you, Shinonome...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is this his way of protecting you...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You really are a nice guy, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I-I'm so sorry, Shinonome...!
It's all my fault for throwing the disc towards you...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Max saved me in the nick of time...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Max is completely different from the dog that chased me around. He's willing to run towards danger to save someone...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ishihara, mind if I tried petting Max again...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Start by letting him sniff your hand...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Being chased around by a dog was definitely traumatizing for Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But Max seems to have succeeded in overwriting that memory...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The possibility that he was just going after the disc Hanasato threw remains...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But it doesn't change the fact that he protected Shinonome. This seems to have become the reason he needed to place his trust in Max.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: In other words, Max's kind and gentle nature helped Shinonome get over his fear of dogs...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Max seems to really enjoy being petted by you, Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, look how much he's wagging his tail!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Sorry for being so scared of you, Max...
I know you never meant to do anything to me.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: This time, I'm going to take the disc back from you.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
You and Max are up soon, Shinonome.
I'm getting so nervous...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Geez, you look more nervous than me.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
Hey, you guys...!
Thanks for coming to cheer us on!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, thanks for coming.
Also, I didn't expect to see you here...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I've been wondering how today was going to go. Also, it's a great chance to gather more data on dogs. I'm looking forward to seeing how you do, Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Still, this is quite an atmosphere...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
All the dogs and their owners look really excited...!

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Oh, Shinonome, you guys should start heading over towards the court...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, those with the highest cumulative scores after the first two rounds advance to the finals?

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: That's right. Which is why it's important to get off to a good start by scoring a lot of points during the first... Oh, hey!

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line: <Next, we have Mr. Shinonome and Max!>

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: They practiced making five mid-range catches during the allotted time...

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: And they should be able to advance to the finals if they get all five...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Your partner's watching, so let's go out there and win!

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
Nice throw, Shinonome!
That's right at the height and distance Max likes.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Next, he needs to get the disc back from Max.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: He did it! He got the disc back from Max!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, they seem to be working in perfect sync.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
There's his second throw...!
Yes, nice catch!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, that's three in a row!

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
*Nod*
If they can keep this up...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Let's make it four in a row, Max!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (No, the disc's being blown off course...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(It fell to the ground...
If only I'd sensed that gust sooner...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (We need to make all five catches. Now there's no chance of us making the finals...)

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: It's not over until it's over, Max!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Right. It's too soon to give up...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (As much as I want to make up for our fourth throw, we don't have time to do six. That means our next one is gonna be our last.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We're going deep for our last throw, Max!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That's so far!
Is Max gonna be able to catch it...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm not sure, but I think he's trying to maximize the number of points they can score.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: B-But they won't get any if Max doesn't catch it...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I threw it even further that first time!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, does this mean you want me to...?

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Yes. After he's pulled off a nice play, he always sits like this and asks for pets.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Congratulations on winning third place, Shinonome, Max!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thanks... But I feel kinda bad about not winning.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
What are you talking about?!
You advanced to the finals on your first try. That by itself is a huge accomplishment.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, you guys were so awesome!

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Thank you again for doing this, Shinonome...

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: You made sure Max's efforts didn't go to waste... As a result, this ended up being a great experience for both me and him.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
So, thank you!
And thank you all for practicing with us and cheering them on... I really appreciate what you did!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you as well. This ended up being quite a valuable experience.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm so happy that you were able to find a way to believe in Max.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And I'm so glad you got a chance to see him compete, Ishihara...!

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Huh...?! Haha. I'm grateful for you too, pal. Thanks for running like I was out there with you.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
What you did was so cool!
I'm proud to have a partner like you!

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: So, next time, we're gonna win! Together!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(We didn't win today...
But I feel like I was able to help them.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We're going deep for our last throw, Max!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I still can't believe we became friends...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the looks of it, I have a feeling that you'll do just fine with other dogs now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hm? Well, I mean...
I feel more comfortable around them now compared to bef—

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: I'm so sorry! I hope my dog didn't startle you...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Nope. This is still gonna take a while.)
